item.title: AI agents set to reshape Indian workplaces as 93% of leaders plan adoption: KPMG-CII report
item.description: Indian businesses are preparing to increasingly deploy artificial intelligence agents across their operations, with 93 per cent of leaders intending to use the technology to expand workforce capabilities and 59 per cent already using AI agents to automate workstreams or business processes, according to a joint report by KPMG in India and the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII).

item.title: Apple iPhone 18e to MacBook Neo 2: 3 upcoming devices that could be easier on Indian buyers’ pockets
item.description: Apple is reportedly preparing three more affordable devices for early 2027, including the iPhone 18e, MacBook Neo 2 and a new entry-level iPad. Here is what the devices could offer and when Indian buyers may get to see them.

item.title: GTA 6 Easter egg takes players back to original Vice City with PS2 graphics: How to unlock it
item.description: GTA 6 players have discovered a hidden Easter egg that transports Jason to a recreation of the original 2002 Vice City, complete with PS2-era graphics, the Malibu Club and familiar characters.&nbsp;

item.title: AI agents emerge as new consumer gatekeepers, businesses urged to optimise for Bot-driven purchases: Report
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are emerging as influential players in consumer purchasing decisions, prompting businesses to rethink their marketing, product visibility and online transaction strategies, according to a new report by venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z).

item.title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo gets ₹6,000 launch offers in India: Check price, specifications and sale date
item.description: Motorola has launched the Edge 70 Neo in India at ₹40,999, featuring a Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chipset, a 144Hz AMOLED display and a 7,000mAh battery. The smartphone gets a 50MP Sony LYTIA camera, Android 16 and launch offers worth up to ₹6,000 ahead of its December 1 sale.

item.title: AI adoption to sustain demand for Indian IT services firms; labour-based models face pressure: Report
item.description: India's IT services companies could continue to benefit from the growing adoption of artificial intelligence as businesses require support for integrating AI solutions, managing data and deploying them at scale, even as automation puts pressure on traditional labour-based delivery models, according to a Systematix report.

item.title: Secret recording, AI errors and privacy risks: Why Dutch watchdog is against camera glasses
item.description: The Dutch Data Protection Authority has urged consumers not to buy AI-powered camera glasses, warning that they pose serious privacy and safety risks. The regulator also flagged cases of AI errors and said recording people in public using these devices is almost always prohibited.

item.title: Engineer turns batteries from 500 discarded vapes into a power pack that ran his home for eight hours
item.description: Electronics engineer Chris Doel recovered 500 lithium batteries from discarded vapes and built a 2.5kWh battery pack. The system powered his home appliances, including a microwave and kettle, for eight hours without using electricity from the grid.

item.title: Apple may launch iPhone 18e, new MacBook Neo and iPads in early 2027: Here is what to expect from its product lineup
item.description: Apple is reportedly preparing several product launches for the first half of 2027, including the iPhone 18e, iPhone 18, new MacBook Neo and updated iPads. The company may split the launches across February, March and April.

item.title: Vivo S70, S70 flagship edition to launch in December: Check expected features and camera details
item.description: Vivo has confirmed that the S70 series, comprising the Vivo S70 and S70 flagship edition, will launch in China in December 2026, with pre-orders now open.

item.title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo India launch on November 24: Check expected price, 7,000mAh battery, camera and other features
item.description: Motorola Edge 70 Neo will launch in India on 24 November with a 7,000mAh battery, 144Hz AMOLED display and Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 processor. Here is everything to know about its camera, charging, features, expected price and availability.

item.title: India may emerge as long-term AI winner despite dependence on foreign tech: Deutsche Bank
item.description: India could emerge as one of the biggest long-term beneficiaries of the global artificial intelligence (AI) revolution, driven by its large population, expanding digital infrastructure, technology workforce and growing demand for AI-based services across sectors, according to a report by Deutsche Bank.

item.title: Xiaomi 18 Pro vs iPhone 18 Pro vs Google Pixel 11 Pro: Price, specifications, features compared
item.description: Xiaomi 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro and Google Pixel 11 Pro go head-to-head with different camera systems, processors, displays and battery capabilities. Here's how the three premium smartphones compare in terms of India price, specifications, features and charging speeds.

item.description: Rockstar Games developers have honoured their late family members with a memorial hidden in GTA 6's Leonida map. The tribute commemorates one developer's late mother and another's father and daughter, allowing players to discover the memorial as they explore the game world.

item.title: How to use auto drive in GTA 6? What does it do? Does it work with boats in the video game? All questions answered
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI’s Auto-Drive feature lets Jason or Lucia travel to a waypoint while players enjoy cinematic views. Available in road vehicles and boats, it still takes time and may struggle with obstacles, so it is best for relaxed journeys rather than pursuits or demanding maneuvers.

item.title: Samsung Galaxy S27 leak: 5 new features leaked so far, from an iPhone-like Now Bar to AI video creation
item.description: Samsung's Galaxy S27 series could bring a redesigned Now Bar inspired by Apple's Dynamic Island, new sports alerts and an AI tool to turn photos into videos. Early software also offers clues about the expected launch and new models.

item.title: AI investment to rise to USD 1.4 trillion in 2027, but returns remain key test: UBS
item.description: Global investment in artificial intelligence is expected to continue expanding in 2027, although technology companies could face increasing pressure to demonstrate that the massive spending is translating into sustainable financial returns, according to UBS.

item.title: Meet Ishita Jain, the Google AI GTM leader driving business growth and working with enterprises across Southeast Asia
item.description: Ishita Jain has joined Google in an AI Go-to-Market role. She will work with enterprises across Southeast Asia to support AI growth. Her previous professional stints include Oracle Corporation and Infosys Limited.

item.title: GTA 6-inspired luxury collection unveiled: Caviar launches gold-plated iPhones, Samsung Fold8 and Ray-Ban smart glasses
item.description: Luxury brand Caviar has unveiled its Most Wanted collection of customised smartphones and Ray-Ban smart glasses inspired by GTA 6. The designs draw on the game’s Miami-inspired aesthetic, featuring neon colours, gold finishes and premium materials.

item.title: GTA 6 console comparison: PS5 Pro takes the lead – why is it the best option? How do PS5 and Xbox stack up?
item.description: A omparison finds the PS5 Pro delivers the best GTA 6 experience, with sharper visuals, extra ray-traced shadows and steadier performance. The standard PS5 and Xbox Series X are broadly similar, while Xbox Series S makes the biggest visual &amp; performance compromises. All four consoles target 30 FPS.

item.title: GTA 6 reportedly cost over $1 billion: How many copies does Rockstar need to sell to recover its budget?
item.description: GTA 6’s development budget is reportedly above $1 billion, but Rockstar has not confirmed the figure. At its $79.99 standard price, the game would need to sell millions of copies to cover its costs, even before other expenses.

item.description: Motorola has named 29 smartphones eligible for Android 17, including models from its Edge, Razr and Moto G series. Nine phones are already receiving the stable update, while 20 more are scheduled to get it in the coming months.

item.title: CERT-In flags unauthorised payments beyond financial sector
item.description: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) has flagged unauthorised payments beyond the financial sector, with reported cases affecting technology service providers that support government-linked payments and platforms that handle payouts to vendors and business partners.

item.title: How many endings does GTA 6 have? Which four factors influence the way your story wraps while playing? What we know
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 reportedly features multiple endings shaped by decisions throughout the campaign. Mission choices, Jason and Lucia’s relationship, players’ criminal behavior, and savings in the couple’s Family Savings account can all influence how their story concludes.

item.title: Apple starts selling iPhone Duo parts for DIY repairs; inner screen priced at $499: What will it cost in India?
item.description: Apple has begun selling genuine iPhone Duo replacement parts for DIY repairs in the US, Canada and Europe, with the inner display priced at $499. The Self Service Repair Store is unavailable in India, where an out-of-warranty inner screen replacement costs ₹1,49,900.
